''See also: [[Alagaeus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Alagaeus was a significant historical and political figure within the [[Aurelian Empire]], serving as the [[Regent of the East]]. He was the second human to occupy the imperial [[throne]] and is credited with building cities, shaping deserts, and laying the empire's foundation. A powerful individual, he possessed the unique ability to read the intentions of entire cities and was known as the [[Soulbound]] to the Heart of the Earth. He also played a role in burying the [[Great Elders]]. Alagaeus utilized a bronze staff and possessed a [[Vessel]] that could amplify his emotions, such as turning his anger into seismic activity. Despite his immense power and reputation, he was assassinated by a peasant, an event that was initially kept secret by officials like Regent{{!}}Regent Loreli. Following his death, his title as [[Regent of the East]] was assumed by Gardener Shera{{!}}Shera Gardener.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Alagaeus was a short and squat [[Heartlander]]. He carried an emerald-topped bronze staff.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|He believed that possessing power granted an individual the right to make choices. His temperament included sneering and grinding his staff against surfaces.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Soulbound]], he was the [[Soulbound]] to the Heart of the Earth. He functioned as a shaper of deserts and a builder of cities.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Alagaeus]] was assassinated.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Soulbound}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Alagaeus serves as the [[Regent of the East]] and is a [[Soulbound]] who has lived for approximately one hundred years.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 1</ref> Known as the shaper of deserts and builder of cities, Alagaeus maintains the belief that power grants an individual the right to make choices.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" /> While it remains possible that Alagaeus survived, the [[Regent]] joined the group following the period when the Emperor began using that title.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] is the [[Regent of the East]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] has lived for approximately one hundred years.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] is a [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] is the shaper of deserts and builder of cities.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] believed that power gives one the right to make choices.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] is a [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|It is possible for [[Alagaeus]] to have survived.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Alagaeus]] joined the group after the Emperor began calling himself the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Alagaeus carries a bronze staff.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Alagaeus is a short, squat [[Heartlander]] who possesses the potential to burn everything built to the ground.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref> Formerly the [[Soulbound]] to the Heart of the Earth, he was among those responsible for burying [[Othaghor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref> He is recognized as the fourth [[Regent]] and possesses a level of talent comparable to [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" /> Carrying an emerald-topped staff, the squat man sneered while grinding his weapon against the dock.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref> Though he once owned a candlewick, his name has since been erased and replaced with Gardener Shera{{!}}Shera Gardener.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] is likely to burn everything built to the ground.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] was the [[Soulbound]] to the Heart of the Earth.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] was one of those who buried [[Othaghor]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A candlewick once belonged to [[Alagaeus]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] is a person [[Loreli]] has talent comparable to.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] is a short, squat [[Heartlander]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] is referred to as the fourth [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] is described as squat with an emerald-topped staff.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]] sneered and ground his staff against the dock.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Alagaeus]]'s name was erased and replaced with Gardener Shera{{!}}Shera Gardener.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>
